resources.name: Open-source Gibbs energy minimization code

access.notes: Suggested solver is GEMS3K; any open-source GEM implementation supporting multiphase ideal solid-solution systems with aqueous electrolytes and Debye-Hückel activity coefficients may be used.

resources.notes: The solver must perform multicomponent Gibbs energy minimization at fixed T, P, bulk composition with user-supplied standard Gibbs energies.

resources.name: Standard Gibbs energies (ΔG°₂₉₈.₁₅) and end-member stoichiometries

access.notes: Provided directly in the instruction document: reference ΔG° for aqueous species and solids (Table 1), and evaluated ΔG° for cement hydrate end-members including CSH, Aft, Afm, hydrogarnet, Htc and the Na end-member (Table 4).

resources.notes: These are the numerical values required to build the thermodynamic system.
